title: S. Jayashree S. Probable NDE 3952
content: There was a white bright light, very chilly weather - I lost my consciousness. My body felt very, very, very light and I had a flying experience. The speed you cannot describe in words, there is no stop for a moment. I traveled in a black tunnel with great speed. I had forgotten everything in this world - even my name, husband, and son, home where I reside and time, day, month, and year - nothing is there in my mind. The speed really threatened a lot and a sudden skip and jerk got me back in this world again. After this experience, I become a different personality with no interest in anything in this world. Even now I remain disinterested in life.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Other after removal of ovarian cyst…laser surgery.. The speed of travelling was threatening me a lot.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Throughout the period the self-level of consciousness and alertness was there. There was also the feeling of threatening and fear - again, because of the speed in travel through the tunnel. I felt like a lifeless ball speeding down from the sky with force. But the motion was towards the sky.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Without the regular eyes there is a super eye in our consciousness - I believe in this. The clarity of the vision is very much more powerful than the regular one.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Initially. Some 'electric voice' similar to a 'robot voice' with the commands of 'open', 'close' - these commands I heard internally.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Initially it was a very bright light then the tunnel was black and cool - and the speed of travelling into the tunnel is incredible.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I pray to the almighty, I felt some power was also travelling along beside me. I don't know who it was.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Very, very bright white light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Chill flying, and afraid first and then joy.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Very much, sometimes I can visualize the future in a flash that would come true within no time. I got this power for quiet sometime and it slowly faded.
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes The boundary I have seen, but I have not reached it.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I am a different personality through this experience.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I am a different personality through this experience. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Words cannot bring the correct form of this experience anyway.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: After this experience I was not able to speak for some time, only to write the experience to share this to my mom.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Something beyond is there in this world and all these days I have spent is ignorance is bliss.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Currently I am okay.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Last year, after listening to me, this homeopathy doctor given me three pills, after taking them I am becoming normal.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It was a nice experience. And now I do not have any fear of death.
